findings.title: No re-check of cache after acquiring write lock causes redundant manifest reloads
findings.body:
The fast path reads `entryPointAssetsCache` under RLock and releases it. It then takes the write lock and unconditionally reloads, without checking the cache again.

At startup or after a cache miss, many concurrent requests can all see `nil`. Each one then queues on the write lock and re-reads and re-parses `assets-manifest.json` in turn, even though the first goroutine already populated the cache. If the CDN path is enabled, each would also issue an HTTP request.

Add a second check after `Lock()` (`if cfg.Env != setting.Dev && entryPointAssetsCache != nil { return entryPointAssetsCache, nil }`), or use `sync.Once`/singleflight for the non-dev case.
